top_issues: Home desktop: the total balance scale bar right edge fades out with an arbitrary gradient blur rather than a precise clip or visceral scale overflow indicator.

Home desktop: action buttons have unequal visual weight where 'Pay' is solid saturated indigo while 'Receive' and 'Swap' are secondary white outline cards, making the resting state feel biased toward spending.
fixes: Home desktop: replace the right-edge gradient fade on the Total balance bar with a hard boundary and an overflow indicator tag ('+ overflow px') when total assets exceed container pixel width.
Home desktop: equalize resting action buttons to neutral elevated cards with consistent indigo icon accents, reserving solid #6E7CFF background for active form submission states.

top_issues: Pay desktop: recipient address in the 'To' card displays as a raw 66-character unformatted hex string, breaking visual polish compared to the truncated address format used in the Route card.
Pay desktop: stray orphan bullet dot '.' rendered directly above the 'Your account with Hub One' row in the Amount card.
fixes: Pay desktop: truncate recipient hex address in the 'To' field to middle-ellipsis format '0x499d0d...64fef2bd' and add an inline copy button.
Pay desktop: remove the orphaned DOM bullet element located immediately above the bilateral balance row in the Amount container.

top_issues: Receipt desktop: simultaneous display of the modal receipt AND a bottom toast banner ('Payment submitted: 25.00 USDC to Meridian Desk') creates redundant visual noise and competing hierarchy.
Receipt desktop: 'Settled: Instantly • 2041 ms' shows a semantic contradiction between the label 'Instantly' and a multi-second execution duration.
fixes: Receipt desktop: suppress the floating bottom submission toast whenever the dedicated receipt dialog is mounted.
Receipt desktop: reformat the timing row to 'Settled in 2.04s' or 'Committed • 2,041 ms' without pairing 'Instantly' with exact multi-second metrics.

top_issues: Receive desktop: layout is a single narrow centered column that leaves >55% of the desktop viewport empty, feeling like an unadapted mobile view.
Receive desktop: persistent bottom toast from a previous payment lingers over the receive view, breaking state context.
Receive desktop: Amount input has an uncharacteristically heavy blue bottom border underline that does not exist on any other input across the wallet.
fixes: Receive desktop: restructure into a two-column desktop layout with QR and Entity ID on the left and active incoming account capacity/counterparty channels on the right.
Receive desktop: remove the non-standard blue bottom underline on the Amount input and align input container styling with 02-pay.
Receive desktop (and 05-swap, 06-account): clear previous transaction toast state upon navigating to a new route.

top_issues: Swap desktop: 'You receive' field shows '0.00' with no indicative exchange rate, slippage limit, or routing fee calculation displayed before user triggers swap.
Swap desktop: right column contains only a single small account card with extensive blank whitespace underneath.
Swap desktop: lingering bottom toast notification from the previous payment remains stuck at the bottom of the viewport.
fixes: Swap desktop: insert a pricing quote breakdown card between input fields showing '1 USDC ≈ 0.000312 WETH', estimated fee, and guaranteed minimum received.
Swap desktop: add an orderbook liquidity depth preview or recent swap route history in the right column beneath the Hub One account card.

top_issues: Account desktop: single-column left-aligned card layout wastes the entire right half of the desktop canvas.
Account desktop: the horizontal color legend ('collateral, credit line, owed, in flight') floats detached above the USDC card rather than acting as a clear caption to the bilateral bar.
fixes: Account desktop: convert to a balanced two-column desktop view placing the credit line terms and bilateral bar in the left column and account activity/dispute proofs in the right column.
Account desktop: move the four-color legend inside the USDC lane card directly beneath the bilateral capacity bar.

top_issues: Activity desktop: empty detail pane on the right is a raw, thin rounded box with unstyled placeholder text ('Select a movement to see its receipt.'), reducing perceived software maturity.
Activity desktop: two consecutive identical rows titled 'Credit limit updated with Hub One • 50,000.00 USDC • updated' offer no timestamp or directional cue to explain the duplicate events.
fixes: Activity desktop: replace the bare outline empty state with an informative card showing aggregate settlement statistics and provable audit trail highlights.
Activity desktop: add explicit directional labels ('Limit extended' vs 'Limit received') and relative timestamps ('10m ago', '1h ago') to disambiguate sequential credit limit updates.

top_issues: Activity detail desktop: stray uncontained 'just now' text string floats orphaned at the bottom left below the activity list card.
Activity detail desktop: receipt card provides verified state data but lacks quick utilitarian actions (e.g. 'Copy proof', 'Export receipt JSON').
fixes: Activity detail desktop: remove the orphaned 'just now' text element floating below the master activity card container.
Activity detail desktop: add secondary utility actions '[ Copy proof ]' and '[ View frame in ledger ]' at the footer of the right-hand receipt detail card.

top_issues: Settings desktop: single narrow column centered on wide desktop creates excessive empty horizontal gutters and unnecessary vertical scrolling.
Settings desktop: continuous slider and discrete preset chips ($1, $2, $5, $10, $25, $100, $1000) for Dollars per pixel duplicate control affordances in the same section.
fixes: Settings desktop: organize settings into a two-column desktop grid placing Scale & Appearance in the left column and Runtime & Vault in the right column.
Settings desktop: consolidate Dollars per pixel into the segmented pill group as primary control, with an optional 'Custom' toggle revealing the slider.

overall.verdict: The light desktop variant delivers crisp typography, strong bilateral balance visualization, and exemplary cryptographic provability cues. However, several screens suffer from narrow single-column mobile layouts stretched across desktop width alongside lingering toast notifications and stray text artifacts.
priority_fixes: Auto-dismiss bottom transaction toasts upon receipt modal display and clear notification state across route changes (affects 03-receipt, 04-receive, 05-swap, 06-account).
Convert single-column desktop layouts on Receive (04), Account (06), and Settings (09) into balanced two-column grids utilizing the full desktop canvas.
Clean visual rendering bugs: eliminate the orphan dot in Pay amount (02) and the stray uncontained 'just now' string in Activity detail (08).
Standardize address formatting to middle-ellipsis truncation with copy icons across 'To' inputs (02), Receive entity IDs (04), and Runtime IDs (09).
Introduce quote/exchange rate disclosures in Swap (05) and replace the right-edge gradient fade on the Total balance bar (01) with a strict scale overflow indicator.
